empty.purpose: Says there are no crates yet.
empty.where: Crates screen, in place of the crate list.

list.label.purpose: Names the list of crates for screen readers.
list.label.where: Crates screen, the list of crates (not shown).

trackCount_zero.purpose: Says a crate has no tracks.
trackCount_zero.where: Crates screen, next to a crate's name in the list.

trackCount_one.purpose: Says a crate has one track.
trackCount_one.where: Crates screen, next to a crate's name in the list.

trackCount_other.purpose: Says how many tracks a crate has.
trackCount_other.where: Crates screen, next to a crate's name in the list.

noTracks.purpose: Says the chosen crate has no tracks.
noTracks.where: Crates screen, right side, in place of the track list.

select.purpose: Asks the user to choose a crate to see its tracks.
select.where: Crates screen, right side, while no crate is chosen.

folder.empty.purpose: Says the chosen folder holds nothing yet.
folder.empty.where: Crates screen, right side, in place of the track list.

folder.select.purpose: Tells the user a folder shows no tracks itself; its crates do.
folder.select.where: Crates screen, right side, for a chosen folder that holds something.

path.label.purpose: Names the line that gives the crate's place in rekordbox for screen readers.
path.label.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen crate or folder (not shown).

path.root.purpose: The top folder every crate and folder is sent under in rekordbox.
path.root.where: Crates screen, first part of the path under the chosen crate's name.

new.button.where: Crates screen, above the crate list.

new.label.purpose: Names the field for the new crate's name.

new.confirm.purpose: Makes the crate with the typed name.

new.cancel.purpose: Closes the new-crate form without making a crate.

newFolder.button.purpose: Starts making a folder for crates.
newFolder.button.where: Crates screen, above the crate list.

newFolder.label.purpose: Names the field for the new folder's name.

newFolder.confirm.purpose: Makes the folder with the typed name.

newFolder.cancel.purpose: Closes the new-folder form without making a folder.

newInside.button.purpose: Starts making a crate inside the chosen folder.
newInside.button.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen folder.

newInside.label.purpose: Names the field for the new crate's name and says which folder it goes in.
newInside.label.where: Crates screen, the new-crate form opened from a folder.

newFolderInside.button.purpose: Starts making a folder inside the chosen folder.
newFolderInside.button.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen folder.

newFolderInside.label.purpose: Names the field for the new folder's name and says which folder it goes in.
newFolderInside.label.where: Crates screen, the new-folder form opened from a folder.

rename.button.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen crate.

rename.label.purpose: Names the field for the crate's new name.

rename.confirm.purpose: Renames the crate to the typed name.

rename.cancel.purpose: Closes the rename form without renaming.

move.button.purpose: Starts moving the chosen crate or folder into another folder or to the top.
move.button.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen crate or folder.

move.label.purpose: Names the choice of where the crate or folder goes.

move.top.purpose: Choice that puts the crate or folder at the top of the tree, outside any folder.

move.confirm.purpose: Moves the crate or folder to the chosen place.

move.cancel.purpose: Closes the move form without moving anything.

delete.button.where: Crates screen, header of the chosen crate.

delete.title.purpose: Asks whether to delete the chosen crate.

delete.detail.purpose: Says the delete can be undone.

delete.folderTitle.purpose: Asks whether to delete the chosen folder and everything in it.
delete.folderTitle.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder.

delete.counting.purpose: Says the confirmation is still counting what the folder holds.
delete.counting.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder, for a moment.

delete.holds.purpose: Introduces what else goes with the folder.
delete.holds.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder that holds something.

delete.holdsNothing.purpose: Says the folder holds no crates or folders.
delete.holdsNothing.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for an empty folder.

delete.crates_one.purpose: Says how many crates go with the folder.
delete.crates_one.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder, in the list.

delete.crates_other.purpose: Says how many crates go with the folder.
delete.crates_other.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder, in the list.

delete.folders_one.purpose: Says how many folders inside it go with the folder.
delete.folders_one.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder, in the list.

delete.folders_other.purpose: Says how many folders inside it go with the folder.
delete.folders_other.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder, in the list.

delete.tracks_one.purpose: Says how many different tracks those crates hold, and that the track is not deleted.
delete.tracks_one.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder, in the list.

delete.tracks_other.purpose: Says how many different tracks those crates hold, and that the tracks are not deleted.
delete.tracks_other.where: Crates screen, delete confirmation for a folder, in the list.

removeTrack.button.purpose: Takes a track out of the chosen crate.
removeTrack.button.where: Crates screen, last cell of each track row.

removeTrack.buttonFor.purpose: Names the Remove button of one track for screen readers.
removeTrack.buttonFor.where: Crates screen, last cell of each track row (not shown).

addTrack.label.purpose: Offers the crates a Library track can be added to.
addTrack.label.where: Library screen, choice in the last cell of each track row.

addTrack.labelFor.purpose: Names one track's Add to crate choice for screen readers.
addTrack.labelFor.where: Library screen, each track row (not shown).

addTrack.none.purpose: Says there is no crate to add to.
addTrack.none.where: Library screen, the greyed-out choice in each track row when there are no crates.

addTrack.added.purpose: Says the track was added to the crate.
addTrack.added.where: Library screen, status strip above the list after an add.

addTrack.alreadyIn.purpose: Says the track was already in the crate, so nothing changed.
addTrack.alreadyIn.where: Library screen, status strip above the list after an add.

addDialog.title.purpose: Names the dialog that adds the selected tracks to a crate.
addDialog.title.where: Dialog opened by the C key or the command palette over a track table, heading.

addDialog.search.purpose: Names the box that finds crates, and says what it is for.
addDialog.search.where: Add to crate or playlist dialog, the text box (label and placeholder).

addDialog.create.purpose: Offers to make a new crate from the typed name and add the tracks to it; {{name}} is what was typed.
addDialog.create.where: Add to crate or playlist dialog, last row of the list while something is typed.

addDialog.none.purpose: Says no crate matches what was typed.
addDialog.none.where: Add to crate or playlist dialog, under the box when the list is empty.

addDialog.cancel.where: Add to crate or playlist dialog, the quiet button at the bottom.

addSelection.newCrateEmpty.purpose: Says the crate asked for in the add dialog was created but no track was added to it, because none could be. The reasons follow in parentheses.
addSelection.newCrateEmpty.where: Above the track table, after tracks were added to a new crate from the dialog and every one was left out.

addSelection.added_zero.purpose: Says nothing was added to the crate, because every track was in it already or was left out. The reasons follow in parentheses.
addSelection.added_zero.where: Above the track table, after tracks were dropped on a crate or added with the C key.

addSelection.added_one.purpose: Says one track was added to the crate.
addSelection.added_one.where: Above the track table, after tracks were dropped on a crate or added with the C key.

addSelection.added_other.purpose: Says how many tracks were added to the crate.
addSelection.added_other.where: Above the track table, after tracks were dropped on a crate or added with the C key.

addSelection.alreadyThere.purpose: Says how many of the tracks were in the crate already, so were not added again.
addSelection.alreadyThere.where: Above the track table, in parentheses after the number added.

addSelection.alsoInLibrary.purpose: Says how many of the tracks added to the crate were not in the Library and were added to it too, in the same step.
addSelection.alsoInLibrary.where: Above the track table, in parentheses after the number added.

addSelection.leftOut.noFile.purpose: Says how many tracks outside the Library were left out of the add because they have no file (the reason Add to Library refuses them).
addSelection.leftOut.noFile.where: Above the track table, in parentheses after the number added.

addSelection.leftOut.fileMissing.purpose: Says how many tracks outside the Library were left out of the add because their file is missing from disk.
addSelection.leftOut.fileMissing.where: Above the track table, in parentheses after the number added.

addSelection.leftOut.matchNotConfirmed.purpose: Says how many tracks outside the Library were left out of the add because their only rekordbox match is uncertain. Same words as the row in All music.
addSelection.leftOut.matchNotConfirmed.where: Above the track table, in parentheses after the number added.

addSelection.leftOut.lowBitrate.purpose: Says how many tracks outside the Library were left out of the add because their file has a low bitrate, which Add to Library asks about first.
addSelection.leftOut.lowBitrate.where: Above the track table, in parentheses after the number added.

addSelection.folder.purpose: Refuses a drop on a folder and says why.
addSelection.folder.where: Above the track table, after tracks were dropped on a folder in the sidebar.

done.deletedFolder.purpose: Says the folder and what was in it were deleted.

done.moved.purpose: Says the crate or folder was moved.

done.removed.purpose: Says the track was taken out of the crate.

error.notFound.where: Any crate action on a crate that is gone.

error.nameEmpty.purpose: Says the crate's name was empty.
error.nameEmpty.where: Crates screen, new-crate and rename forms.

error.nameTaken.purpose: Says another crate already has the name.
error.nameTaken.where: Crates screen, new-crate and rename forms.

error.nameUnsendable.purpose: Says the name has a character rekordbox can't take.
error.nameUnsendable.where: Crates screen, new-crate and rename forms.
error.nameUnsendable.approved: Name has a character that can't be sent to rekordbox. Remove it and try again.

error.notAFolder.purpose: Says the place chosen for a crate or folder is a crate, not a folder.
error.notAFolder.where: Crates screen, new-crate, new-folder and move forms.

error.moveIntoItself.purpose: Says why a folder can't be moved there.

error.tooDeep.purpose: Says the folders would be nested deeper than a send to rekordbox can write.
error.tooDeep.where: Crates screen, new-folder and move forms.

error.folderNotFound.where: Any folder action on a folder that is gone.

error.folderNameEmpty.purpose: Says the folder's name was empty.
error.folderNameEmpty.where: Crates screen, new-folder and rename forms, for a folder.

error.folderNameTaken.purpose: Says another crate or folder in the same folder already has the name.
error.folderNameTaken.where: Crates screen, new-folder, rename and move forms, for a folder.
